notes: Curated cases for the RTI-first-appeal (Right to Information Act, 2005, Section 19(1)) complaint-drafter scenario. Each case runs the actual Pydantic validator + citation-resolution + template-assembly pipeline in complaint_drafter.py -- nothing here is mocked. No LLM call anywhere in the path. NOT covered here: check_no_response_received_period_has_expired (rejects a deemed-refusal appeal filed before the 30-day Section 7(1) period has actually expired) -- that check's pass/fail boundary moves with 'today', so a fixed-date case here would silently go stale; it's covered instead by a pytest test that computes its dates relative to datetime.date.today() at test-run time (tests/test_rti_first_appeal.py).
